facts_found: The cash back dispute process is used when a customer believes there is a discrepancy between cash back received and cash back that should have been received for a particular credit card transaction; it applies to all credit card transactions. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_003]

There is no step-by-step agent workflow for filing; instead the agent instructs the customer to use the tool directly: submit_cash_back_dispute_0589(user_id: str, transaction_id: str), run by the customer with their own user_id and the transaction_id of the purchase in question. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_003]

Agent notes for cash back disputes: confirm the customer has the correct transaction_id before they submit; do not collect sensitive card details because the tool uses user-provided identifiers; advise that supporting context (category or promotion expectations) may be requested later during review. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_003]

Correction is performed only AFTER a cash back dispute is resolved and approved; the agent must then update the affected transaction(s) with the correct rewards value. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

Step 1 of correction: look up the user's resolved disputes in the cash_back_disputes database to find the transaction_id values that need rewards adjustments. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]
Step 2 of correction: use unlock_discoverable_agent_tool to unlock the agent tool update_transaction_rewards_3847. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

Step 3 of correction: recalculate correct rewards per transaction based on card type, transaction category, and any applicable promotions; do NOT rely on any expected_rewards field in the dispute record — independently verify rates and eligibility. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

Step 4 of correction: use call_discoverable_agent_tool to invoke update_transaction_rewards_3847 with transaction_id (exact transaction identifier) and new_rewards_earned (a string formatted as 'X points' where X is the correct whole-number point value). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

Compliance requirements for corrections: the calculation must reflect the proper base rate and any active bonus category or promotion at the time of purchase; confirm the update in credit_card_transaction_history after the tool call completes; retain calculation notes in the internal case record for auditability. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_004]

Customer-facing guidance lists qualifying reasons to contact support: a bonus-category purchase that only received the standard rate, missing higher reward rate, amount lower than calculated, no rewards at all, or a suspected merchant miscategorization. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_021]

Customer-facing guidance says the customer service team investigates discrepancies, verifies merchant category, checks applicable reward rates, and applies the correct amount if the customer was shortchanged; useful info to have is transaction date, merchant name and purchase amount, received vs. expected cash back, and receipts. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_021]
Customer contact channels for missing/incorrect cash back: 1-800-RHO-BANK, chat in the Rho-Bank mobile app, or rhobank.com/help. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_021]

A user's credit card dispute history (including dispute_id, status, transaction_id, transaction_date, merchant_name, amount, reason_code, outcome, notes) can be retrieved with get_user_dispute_history_7291(user_id). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_016]

Rewards in the transaction database are stored as points for cash back cards including Silver Rewards Card and Business Silver Rewards Card, with 1 point = $0.01 when redeemed as a statement credit or checking account credit. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006]
All credit card rewards points are rounded down (floored/truncated) to the nearest whole number per purchase across all card types and reward categories. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007]

The cash back dispute path is distinct from the formal credit card transaction dispute path (file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829), which is for unauthorized charges, merchant issues, and billing errors, and from provisional-credit rules that apply to transaction disputes rather than rewards. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_014]

For Business Gold Rewards Card operations spend, the documented customer-facing route for a purchase that did not earn the bonus rate is to contact support with transaction details and merchant information for category review/reclassification, consistent with the cash back dispute flow. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_gold_rewards_card_002]

The Business Silver double cash back promotion is applied automatically to qualifying transactions with no separate enrollment, and cash back is credited at the end of each billing cycle consistent with program rules. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_012]

facts_found: Business Silver Rewards Card earns 10.0% cash back on eligible travel and software purchases and 1.0% on all other purchases. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_002]

For the 10.0% rate the merchant must process the transaction under a travel or software-related merchant category; rewards depend on the merchant's submitted category code, not the nature of the goods. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_002]

Online purchases qualify for 10.0% only if billed by the service provider itself or by an authorized platform categorized as travel or software. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_002]

If a merchant sells multiple categories of goods or services, only the charge (or portion) coded under a qualifying category earns 10.0%; the remainder earns the base 1.0%. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_002]

Qualifying travel examples for Business Silver: airfare, lodging, car rentals, transit and other travel booked directly with providers or recognized travel agencies. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_002]

Qualifying software examples for Business Silver: SaaS productivity/collaboration/videoconferencing/office suites, CRM, ERP, accounting and project management subscriptions, cloud infrastructure and developer tools billed as software services, cybersecurity/endpoint/identity management, marketing automation, analytics and content management platforms. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_004]

A Business Silver travel/software purchase that appears misclassified can be submitted for category review so the correct earning rate is applied. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_010]

The Business Silver double-cash-back promo states that merchant category exclusions continue to apply and cross-references an 'Exceptions and Exclusions' section; the Business Silver exclusions list itself was not retrievable in the knowledge base. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_012]

For the sibling Silver Rewards Card, transactions that typically do not qualify for the enhanced rate are gift cards, person-to-person payments, fees, interest, insurance premiums charged by the bank, and returned or refunded purchases (rewards are reversed when credits post). [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_002]

For the Silver Rewards Card, situations that may not qualify for the travel rate include in-flight/onboard purchases coded as retail or food, vacation-rental or home-sharing platforms coded under real estate or miscellaneous, parking garages/tolls/local transit not classified as travel, and purchases through third-party payment processors that mask the travel category. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_003]
Third-party wallets and processors may alter merchant classification, so paying the merchant directly is required to capture the bonus category rate. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_002]

Rewards are calculated after the transaction posts, not at authorization, and final amounts may adjust if the merchant updates the transaction or issues a credit. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_002]

2x new-customer promo: new Business Silver Rewards Card customers earn 2x cash back on all purchases for the first 6 months after opening the account. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_012]

Promo period start date is 2024-11-14 and end date is 2025-11-14; the customer must open the account during this promotional period to qualify. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_012]
The 6-month doubled-rate window begins on the account opening date, NOT on the promotional start date. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_012]

During the promo window, travel and software purchases that normally earn 10.0% are multiplied by 2 (i.e., 20.0%), and other purchases that normally earn 1.0% are multiplied by 2 (i.e., 2.0%). [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_012]

The increased promotional rewards rate is applied automatically to qualifying transactions with no separate enrollment required, and cash back is credited at the end of each billing cycle. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_012]

The retrieved Business Silver rewards-rate documents state no bonus-category spend cap or maximum bonus cash back limit for travel/software. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_002]
